easy.q: How many days are in a leap year?
easy.fact: Leap days came in with Julius Caesar's calendar in 45 B.C.

easy.q: How many dice do you roll in a game of Yahtzee?
easy.fact: Rolling five of a kind scores 50 points.

easy.q: In a tennis game, what score comes after 15 and 30?
easy.fact: A score of zero in tennis is called "love."

easy.q: How many straight sides make up Wyoming's border on a map?
easy.fact: Colorado and Wyoming are the only states bounded entirely by lines of latitude and longitude.

easy.q: How many Hemsworth brothers are Hollywood actors?
easy.fact: Chris played Thor, Liam starred in The Hunger Games films, and Luke appeared in Westworld.

medium.q: As of the 2026 NFL season, how many Super Bowls has Patrick Mahomes won?
medium.fact: He won Super Bowl MVP in all three of those wins.

medium.q: In what year did Sonic the Hedgehog first race onto the Sega Genesis?
medium.fact: Sonic was created to give Sega a mascot to rival Nintendo's Mario.

medium.q: Rhode Island, the smallest state, is about how many miles long from north to south?
medium.fact: It's about 37 miles wide from east to west.

medium.q: Magellan's expedition left Spain in 1519 with five ships. How many of them completed the trip around the world?
medium.fact: The Victoria limped home in 1522 with only 18 of about 270 crewmen.

medium.q: How many seasons did The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air run?
medium.fact: It aired on NBC from 1990 to 1996 and made Will Smith a TV star.

hard.q: President John Tyler fathered more children than any other U.S. president. How many?
hard.fact: His last child was born in 1860, when Tyler was 70.

hard.q: How many NASCAR Cup Series races did Richard "The King" Petty win, the all-time record?
hard.fact: He also won seven Cup championships and seven Daytona 500s.

hard.q: Denver is called the Mile High City. How many feet above sea level is the marked step of Colorado's Capitol?
hard.fact: The 13th step of the State Capitol is engraved "One Mile Above Sea Level."

hard.q: How many No. 1 hits has Madonna had on the Billboard Hot 100?
hard.fact: Her first was Like a Virgin in 1984.
